title: Intake security hardening: idempotency namespace, encrypted suggestions, pattern guard, answer size caps
story: Close SEC3 intake mediums and wire intake submit to the new enrichment hook.
acceptance: Client Idempotency-Key is namespaced as intake:<sessionId>:<key> before createClaim; default remains intake:<sessionId>; test shows a key equal to another session's key cannot return another claim (security-idempotency.test.js)

doc.suggestions values are encrypted with ctx.crypto.encryptPii when saved and decrypted on read; raw DB row contains no narrative text; suggestions are purged on submit and on session expiry (security-suggestions.test.js)

validation.pattern guard rejects adjacent/repeated unbounded quantifiers (e.g. a+*, (a+)+, a*a*) and counted groups with optional bodies (e.g. (a?){1,50}); pattern-question input is capped at 200 chars; evaluation is time-boxed; unsafe patterns are skipped with no hang (security-pattern.test.js)
Structured answer value over 16 KB (serialized) is rejected with 400 per-question error; total answers per session over 512 KB rejected (security-size.test.js)

submit calls mapping.enrichClaimCreate when exported (namespace import, optional call) before createClaim, passing session, answers, questions and a getSnapshot using mod('coverage').getPolicySnapshot; absence of the export must not break submit
All named tests pass plus existing tests/unit/intake/*.test.js; only listed paths changed
brief: Read architecture/security-gate-s3.json intake entries (service.js idempotency ~265, suggestions plaintext, questions.js isSafePattern lines 12-40 and 121-124). Build helpers in new src/modules/intake/security.js and wire them. (1) Idempotency: in service.submit use `intake:${sessionId}:${key}` when a client key is given (key capped to 128 chars, charset-limited), else `intake:${sessionId}`. (2) Suggestions: mergeSuggestions/saveDoc store doc.suggestions plaintext. Seal values via ctx.crypto.encryptPii when saving and open on read in conversation/service; delete doc.suggestions on submit and in the expiry sweep. Verify the encryptPii signature in core-runtime-api.md; follow how intake_answers already encrypts. (3) Pattern guard: strengthen isSafePattern: reject nested/adjacent/repeated unbounded quantifiers (*,+,{n,}) and groups with optional bodies under counts; cap pattern length; cap tested input to 200 chars (answers longer than that fail validation for pattern questions); time-box: run the regex in a bounded way (precheck is primary; node:vm with timeout option is acceptable for a hard bound). Keep existing valid patterns working (phone, postal code). (4) Size caps: reject any structured (object/array) answer whose JSON length exceeds 16384 bytes and any session whose summed answer size exceeds 524288 bytes, via the existing per-question errors[] 400 envelope. (5) Hook: story 1 (ticket S4-WFL-01, parallel) adds async mapping.enrichClaimCreate(input,{session,answers,questions,getSnapshot}) in mapping.js. In submit do `import * as mapping from './mapping.js'` and `const enriched = typeof mapping.enrichClaimCreate === 'function' ? await mapping.enrichClaimCreate(...) : input`. Do not edit mapping.js. Reuse tests/unit/intake/helpers.mjs and fakes.mjs (read only; add your own helpers inside your new test files). Pitfalls: never log answer or narrative content; keep ES module style; do not change response shapes.
